answer: A prism of independent checks can split each applicant's history: every identity must present a juniper-rooted chain of externally attested work, each link countersigned by unrelated established agents, with a slashable bond that doubles per identity sharing one funding source. The tenth fake identity then costs 512 units of bond plus roughly 1,000 hours of genuinely attested work no farm can mint for itself.
